hook: Their boat flipped. A beacon called for help.
narration: [tense] A twelve-foot fishing boat flipped off Oahu, [short pause] and two men went into the ocean.
[calm documentary narrator] The Coast Guard got an alert from a personal locator beacon. It sends a distress signal and a position by satellite, so rescuers know exactly where to fly.
[building energy] A Dolphin crew from Air Station Barbers Point lowered the basket, [short pause] one man at a time.
outcome: [warm, relieved] The Barbers Point crew hoisted both men out of the water.
title: Flipped off Oahu, saved by a beacon
description:
A 12-foot fishing vessel capsized offshore Oahu on July 3, 2026, putting two men in the water. After a personal locator beacon alert, an MH-65 Dolphin crew from Coast Guard Air Station Barbers Point rescued both men.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, courtesy Air Station Barbers Point, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/1013516
